headlines.title: ‘ 1조 달러 ’ 한국 수출 … 60년간 세계평균 2배 속도로 질주했다
headlines.summary: 대한상의 “연평균 16.6% 성장” ‘1000억→1조 달러’ 31년 걸려 우리나라가 세계에서 네 번째로 연간 1조 달러(약 1341조 원) 시대를 연 가운데, 지난 60여 년간 국내 수출 연평균 증가율은 세계 평균의 2배에 육박했다는 분석 결과가 나왔다.

headlines.title: 기업 체감경기 한 달 만에 꺾여 …내수 기업 은 4년 반 만에 최고
headlines.summary: 기업 체감 경기가 한 달 만에 다시 꺾였습니다. 한국은행이 오늘(25일) 발표한 '11월 기업경기조사 결과'를 보면, 이달 전산업 기업심리지수(CBSI)는 103.5로 지난달보다 0.7포인트 하락했습니다. 지난달 4년여 만에 최고치인 104.2를 기록했지만, 한 달 만에 다시 악화한 겁니다.

headlines.title: “ 뽑아도 2년 못 버틴다 ”… 중소기업 연구인력 2.8만명 감소
headlines.summary: 연구인력 중 중기 비중 54%→46% 중기 신입 연구원 절반 근속 2년 미만 대기업의 연구개발(R&D) 인력은 늘어났으나 중소기업 인력은 통계적으로 유의미하게 줄어든 것으로 집계됐다. 중소기업 연구인력이 전체 기업 인력에서 차지하는 비중도 절반 아래로 떨어졌다. 중소기업에 입사한 연구인력의 50% 가량은 재직기간이 2년 미만인 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 韓 수소차 5만대 선점했지만 … 10만대 고지 중국에 내줄 위기
headlines.summary: 韓 올해 판매량 세계 1위, 점유율 69% 내년 수소차 보급 예산 23%↓, 업계 우려 中 ‘수소굴기 2.0’ 본격화, 1.6조 장려금 “지자체 매칭부담 낮추고 국비지원 확대” 세계 최초로 수소전기차 5만대 보급을 달성한 한국이 10만대 고지는 중국에 내줄 위기에 처했다.

headlines.title: 美 과잉생산 관세 발표 임박 … 韓 ' 15% 상한' 지킬까
headlines.summary: [앵커] 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한국을 비롯한 주요 교역국을 대상으로 이른바 '과잉생산 관세' 부과를 예고했습니다. 기존 한미 무역합의에 따른 15% 관세율이 유지될지 주목되는데요. 우형준 기자, 이르면 오늘(25일) 발표될수도 있다고 하는데, 나왔나요? [기자] 아직입니다.

headlines.title: ‘ 닥공 ’ 발목 잡는 표준건축비 … 정부, 폐지 검토
headlines.summary: 낮은 매입단가에 LH공모사업 부진 국토부, 3년 동결 건축비 현실화나서 원가 반영 부실…개선안 마련도 착수 정부가 2023년 이후 3년 넘게 동결된 공공건설임대주택 표준건축비 현실화에 나선다. 자재비와 인건비 상승에도 표준건축비가 제때 조정되지 않으면서 사업성이 악화하고 주택 공급에도 차질이 빚어지고 있다는 지적에 따른 것이다.

headlines.title: ‘ 햇볕 가뭄 ’에 물가 비상 … 상추 값 121%·깻잎 88% 뛰었다
headlines.summary: ■ 일조량 부족… 채소 도매가 폭등 10~11월 평년比 햇볕 23% 부족 생육 지연에 애호박 184%  올라 김장수요 겹쳐 식재료 비용 부담 정부 2%대 물가관리에 ‘먹구름’ 10월 하순부터 흐린 날씨가 계속되고 일조량이 부족해지면서 채소 도매가격이 급등한 데 이어 소비자가격도 오르며 가계의 밥상 물가 부담이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 올해 1 ∼ 9월 태어난 아기 21만9천명 … 증가율 역대 최고
headlines.summary: 작년보다 14.3% 늘어…1981년 통계 집계 이래 최고 3분기 출산율 0.90명…혼인은 11분기 만에 감소 올해 1∼9월 태어난 아기 21만9천명…증가율 역대 최고 (서울=연합뉴스) 류효림 기자 = 올해 들어 3분기까지 태어난 아기가 작년보다 14% 넘게 증가하며 21만명을 넘었다. 증가율은 역대 최고 수준이다.

headlines.title: 10월 국내 이동자 45만3천명 … '반도체 밀집' 충청권 순유입
headlines.summary: 충남·충북 2천276명 순유입…서울 5천560명 순유출 추석 기저효과에 이동자 2.6% 증가…장기 감소세 지속 10월 국내 이동자 45만3천명 (서울=연합뉴스) 김주형 기자 = 지난 8월 30일 서울 영등포구 여의도 63빌딩 전망대에서 바라본 시내 곳곳에 자리 잡은 아파트 전경. 2026.8.

headlines.title: 거래소에 ‘ 지분 장벽 ’… 중개 · 운용에 ‘ 새 길 ’
headlines.summary: 판 바뀌는 디지털자산시장 지분 재편 불가피 글로벌 최대 거래소 바이낸스도 규제 사정권 매매업자 유동성 공급, MM 제도권 진입 주목 디지털자산기본법 정부안이 공개되면서 국내 디지털자산 업계의 희비가 엇갈리고 있다.

headlines.title: AI·금리 불확실에 ‘ 증시 멀미주의보 ’
headlines.summary: 사이드카 코스피 62·코스닥 40회 금융위기 2008년 넘은 ‘역대 최다’ 220 거래일 동안 ‘이틀에 한번 꼴’ 최근 미 금리인상·AI 급변동 확대 올해 국내 증시를 관통하는 핵심 키워드는 ‘변동성’이다. 주가 급등락에 따른 충격을 완화하기 위한 사이드카는 올해 들어서만 100차례 넘게 발동됐다.

key_headlines.title: Stock Market Volatility Hits Record Highs Amid AI and Rate Uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market has experienced record volatility with circuit breakers triggered over 62 times on KOSPI and 40 times on KOSDAQ, surpassing the 2008 financial crisis frequency. The volatility is driven by US rate hikes and rapid AI market fluctuations.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Achieves $1 Trillion Annual Export Milestone
key_headlines.summary: South Korea became the fourth country to reach $1 trillion in annual exports, achieving this milestone in 31 years with an average annual growth rate of 16.6%, nearly double the global average over 60 years.

key_headlines.title: Jensen Huang's Return to NVIDIA Triggers 31% Stock Surge and Market Recovery
key_headlines.summary: NVIDIA stock surged 31.48% following CEO Jensen Huang's return announcement, adding $952 billion in market value and sparking a broader rally that helped KOSPI recover above the 5,000 level after recent sharp declines.

key_headlines.title: Severe Sunshine Drought Causes Vegetable Price Inflation Exceeding 100%
key_headlines.summary: South Korea faces an emergency price situation as October-November sunshine fell 23% below normal, causing vegetable wholesale prices to spike dramatically with lettuce up 121% and perilla leaves up 88%, threatening the government's 2% inflation target.

key_headlines.title: US Tariff Threats Loom Over Korea with 15% Rate at Stake
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration has announced plans to impose 'overproduction tariffs' on major trading partners including South Korea, with potential implementation as early as November 25, while questioning whether the existing 15% tariff ceiling from the Korea-US trade agreement will be maintained.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's stock market continues to experience unprecedented volatility, with circuit breakers triggered more frequently than during the 2008 financial crisis, now occurring roughly every two trading days. The country achieved a historic $1 trillion annual export milestone, the fourth globally, with growth rates nearly double the world average over six decades. However, economic stability remains fragile as external pressures from US tariffs and AI market fluctuations combine with domestic challenges including severe vegetable price inflation exceeding 100% due to insufficient sunshine, threatening the government's price management goals. Jensen Huang's return as NVIDIA CEO sparked a brief market recovery with KOSPI reclaiming the 5,000 level, though underlying concerns persist.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Despite the KOSPI's recent sharp decline to 4,700 levels, economic analysts maintain that the probability of financial crisis or economic recession in South Korea remains low. The Korea Development Institute has upgraded next year's GDP growth forecast to 3.9%, with expectations for further upward revisions from the Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee meeting on November 26. South Korea's semiconductor export sector continues showing robust growth trends, underpinning economic fundamentals even as stock market volatility creates uncertainty. The central bank faces a dilemma between controlling inflation driven by vegetable price spikes and stabilizing financial markets amid capital outflows, while Argentina has entered technical recession with two consecutive quarters of negative growth.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI experienced significant volatility, declining to the 4,700 level on November 23 amid heavy selling, only to recover above 5,000 following Jensen Huang's return announcement at NVIDIA, with the company's shares surging 31.48% and adding $952 billion in market value. Foreign investors and institutional buyers have shifted back to purchasing mode following the brief recovery, though underlying market instability persists with mounting concerns about the National Pension Service's fund operations affecting supply-demand dynamics. The KOSDAQ index declined to two-year lows amid broader tech stock weakness, though the momentum shifted dramatically following positive AI sector developments. Trading volume and circuit breaker activations remain elevated, with both buying and selling-triggered circuit breakers activated repeatedly across both markets, indicating extreme market swings.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung Electronics promoted 131 executives in its regular personnel reshuffle, with 39 becoming senior vice presidents, heavily favoring semiconductor, artificial intelligence, and robotics divisions as future growth engines, marking record female executive appointments. Sam Energy Solutions is expanding into defense manufacturing by supplying battery packs for unmanned ground vehicles developed under government R&D projects, with operations now based in Gwangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. S-Oil completed the $9 billion Shaheen project in partnership with Saudi Aramco, marking expansion beyond traditional refining into petrochemicals, symbolizing strengthened Korea-Saudi bilateral cooperation in energy and technology sectors. The company is positioning itself for future growth in areas including electric vehicles, semiconductors, and digital infrastructure development.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment leasing market is shifting from jeonse (long-term rental deposits) to monthly rental contracts as jeonse inventory disappears, with monthly rents now surpassing jeonse rates in the Seoul metropolitan area. Among Seoul apartment subscription applicants in the first nine months of 2026, 80.8% selected units under 60 square meters, the highest proportion since 2000 began being tracked, as rising apartment prices force homebuyers to downsize their housing aspirations. Gangnam apartment jeonse rates have rebounded to 17-month highs at 39.22%, narrowing the gap with sales prices, as reconstruction profit-sharing schemes and high interest rates pressure sales prices while rental values continue rising. The government's August 3 tax reform announcement has led to increased apartment inventory across Seoul, particularly spreading from Gangnam to other areas, though sales price momentum has begun to slow.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration has announced imminent 'overproduction tariffs' targeting South Korea, China, Japan, EU and other major trading partners, with South Korea potentially facing additional tariffs between 2.5-5%, while the existing 15% rate ceiling from Korea-US trade agreements remains uncertain. The Fed is facing inflationary pressures from potential Trump tariff policies that could increase consumer goods prices, potentially forcing extended interest rate hikes despite market volatility concerns and broader economic softening risks. US stock market performance remains mixed following profit-taking in AI and technology stocks, while NASDAQ declined 1.5% despite Jensen Huang's return momentum, with new Anthropic IPO pricing below the offered range amid broader market uncertainty. France faces recession risks driven by weak domestic demand, rising sovereign bond yields, and fiscal deficit concerns, adding to broader European economic uncertainties.
sections.AI & Economy: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Wash warned that disappointing AI investment returns could trigger stock value declines and economic slowdown with rising unemployment, as the technology sector faces potential headwinds from reduced tax incentives, antitrust investigations, and regulatory scrutiny on big tech companies. China's ByteDance has launched a personalized AI agent called 'XiaoDou' in beta testing, competing with Tencent and Meta by integrating SNS, calendar, and health apps to handle tasks like pet food reordering and restaurant reservations. South Korea's AI healthcare sector is expanding with ITAIZ supplying medical AI agent solutions to Hwasun Jeonnam University Hospital and C-EARS opening its first regional office in Gwangju to expand adoption beyond major teaching hospitals. Next year's economic outlook hinges significantly on AI investment trends, Middle East geopolitical developments, and unpredictable Trump administration policies, with infrastructure investment potentially delayed but unlikely to be abandoned entirely.
sections.Others: Coupang Fulfillment Service is holding a mid-career job recruitment fair on November 27 in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, planning to hire approximately 100 workers. The AI sector expansion is impacting job markets for accounting professionals, with recruitment demand potentially declining up to 8.5% annually as AI automation tools handle accounting tasks more efficiently, with potential 23% reduction within three years absent regulatory safeguards. Jensen Huang's return has rejuvenated AI credit market tensions and capital mobilization in the technology sector, as NVIDIA regains its role as the 'central bank' of artificial intelligence funding and development. Media commentary highlights the symbolic importance of Huang's return to AI sector momentum and global technology leadership perceptions amid broader economic uncertainty.
